svg.aria-label: About Muhammad Shees — work and life
svg.title: About — Muhammad Shees

g.text: Interfaces to infrastructure — owned fully, start to finish.
Audits, automated tests and CI on every project I ship.
Agents do the typing. Decisions and final calls stay mine.
The rig that games at night ships code by day.
Every new agent workflow gets tried, measured —
kept if it earns its place, dropped if it doesn't.
Degree on one side, production code on the other.
ADSE diploma completed at Aptech, Karachi.
